caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with an ornate design, shown from the front, without its seat cushion. The chair is brown with decorative floral and foliage patterns rendered in lighter tan, green, and pink colors on the top rail, the central back splat, and the lower front rail. The back of the chair curves outward at the top and then narrows toward the seat, with a pierced splat featuring floral motifs and symmetrical inlay work. The arms of the chair curve downward and outward from the backrest, creating an open, scroll-like appearance. The arm supports are vertical and angular, while the area where the seat would be is left open, with no visible upholstery or seat panel. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects present, and at the bottom of the image, the words "WESTCHESTER COUNTY." and "EDMOND W. BROWN." are written in black ink, separated by the width of the chair.
title: Pa. German Rocking Chair
